general-catalyst._readme: Identity merges for General Catalyst (PRO-166). The firm's /list publishes legal names and the portfolio grid the brand; Form D names the registrant. Canonical is the grid's rendering where there is one. A holding company whose platform is a control position is not merged: it takes its own control verdict, because the build applies exclusions before merges (COLLECTION.md 8). Pairs the judge ruled distinct are under never_merge.

JAND, Inc. is Warby Parker's legal name
